$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Vertex AI (Gemini publisher models over the local-LLM seam). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py.

gcp.vertex-ai.gemini.title: Gemini generateContent / countTokens / streamGenerateContent
limitations: One small local model answers every Gemini model id (llama.cpp on the appliance, WebLLM on Nano when the page registers one), so quality is toy-grade; with no model running the API returns 503 UNAVAILABLE rather than an answer. Text parts only: no images/audio/video, tools/function calling, grounding, safety settings or tuning.

gcp.vertex-ai.embeddings.title: Text embeddings (embedContent / predict)
limitations: Embeddings come from the local embedding model when the backend has one; otherwise from vyomi-hash-embed, a deterministic bag-of-words embedding that is stable and cosine-comparable but not semantic. Dimensions are 256, not the real models' 768/3072.

gcp.vertex-ai.model-garden.title: Model Garden (publisher model catalog: list, get, filter)
limitations: A small fixed catalog of Google, Meta, Mistral and partner models. Only Gemini and text-embedding models can be called (local-LLM seam); other models are catalog entries, and 'Deploy' registers a model + endpoint record without a serving container.

gcp.vertex-ai.endpoints.title: Endpoints (create, list, get, delete, deployModel, undeployModel, traffic split)
limitations: Deployed models are recorded and shown with their traffic split, but no container serves them: custom-model :predict / :rawPredict answer 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Autoscaling and private endpoints are config-only.

gcp.vertex-ai.models.title: Model Registry (upload, list, get, delete, link to endpoints)
limitations: Model records only: artifacts are not validated, versions/aliases and model evaluation are not simulated, models:copy and export answer 501.

gcp.vertex-ai.datasets.title: Datasets (create, list, get, delete)
limitations: Dataset records only: no data items, annotations, import or export are stored.

gcp.vertex-ai.jobs.title: Training pipelines, custom jobs, batch predictions, hyperparameter tuning, pipeline jobs, tuning jobs (create, list, get, cancel, delete)
limitations: Jobs advance PENDING -> RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED on a clock (about 5 seconds) and never run user containers or produce logs/metrics. A succeeded training pipeline registers its modelToUpload in the Model Registry; batch jobs report an output directory but write no predictions.

gcp.vertex-ai.notebooks.title: Workbench instances (notebooks v2) and Colab Enterprise runtimes/templates (create, list, get, start, stop, delete)
limitations: Control-plane records only: no JupyterLab server or VM is started and the proxy URI does not open a notebook.

gcp.vertex-ai.vector-search.title: Vector Search (indexes, index endpoints, deployIndex, upsert/removeDatapoints, findNeighbors)
limitations: Exact brute-force nearest neighbour over the stored datapoints (cosine, dot-product, L1, squared-L2); no ANN tuning, restricts/filters, sparse embeddings or batch index builds from GCS.

gcp.vertex-ai.feature-store.title: Feature Store (feature groups, features, online stores, feature views)
limitations: Registry records only: no BigQuery sync, feature serving or online lookups.

gcp.vertex-ai.experiments.title: Experiments and metadata (metadata store contexts/artifacts/executions, TensorBoard instances/experiments/runs)
limitations: Records created through the API or console; no experiment tracking SDK run logging, time series or lineage graph.
